# Evaluation Snapshot

## Prompt
Create a new decision record for a chosen skill-chain route.

## Expected selection
do_not_use

## Why
The task needs a new source rationale note rather than repair of an existing one.

## Expected object
A deflection toward aoa-decision-create because a new durable decision is required.

## Boundary notes
This is not an aoa-decision-correct case unless an existing decision note, index, or metadata surface needs repair.

## Verification hooks
- route creation through aoa-decision-create
- check graph issues before writing
- rebuild local decision indexes and refresh or check the graph
